title: What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn? (It Might Have Once)
description:
What would Earth look like with rings like Saturn? This science-based scenario shows how a ring could form, how it might look from the ground, and what it could do to winters and satellites. Then the real twist: researchers found 21 craters from about 466 million years ago, all near the ancient equator, a hint that Earth may once have had a ring. It's still a hypothesis, not a settled fact.

Astronomy Magazine, Did Earth once have a ring?: https://www.astronomy.com/science/did-earth-once-have-a-ring/
